userStories.title: Install Drizzle ORM + expo-sqlite
userStories.description: Add Drizzle ORM and expo-sqlite to the mobile app. Configure Drizzle for SQLite dialect. Create database initialization hook.
acceptanceCriteria: drizzle-orm and expo-sqlite installed in apps/mobile
Database file created at app launch (coparent.db)
useDatabase hook initializes and provides db instance
App runs on iOS and Android without errors

userStories.title: Database schema — core tables
userStories.description: Define SQLite schema with Drizzle ORM: users, relationships, children, entries, entry_versions, attachments, acknowledgments, disputes, audit_logs. All tables support audit trail and immutability.
acceptanceCriteria: users: id, email, display_name, timezone, default_currency, created_at
relationships: id, parent_a_id, parent_b_id, invite_token, created_at
children: id, relationship_id, name, date_of_birth, created_at
entries: id, relationship_id, child_id, type (expense|event|agreement|communication|upload), created_by, created_at, status, current_version_id
entry_versions: id, entry_id, version_number, content_json, diff_json, created_by, created_at
attachments: id, entry_version_id, original_filename, storage_path, file_hash, file_size_bytes, mime_type, uploaded_at
acknowledgments: id, entry_id, status (pending|acknowledged|disputed), acted_by, created_at, comment
disputes: id, entry_id, raised_by, reason_text, created_at
dispute_responses: id, dispute_id, responded_by, response_text, created_at
audit_logs: id, user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata_json, created_at
All IDs are UUIDs (text in SQLite)
created_at fields default to current timestamp

userStories.title: Database migrations setup
userStories.description: Configure Drizzle migrations for SQLite. Create initial migration from schema. Add migration runner that executes on app startup.
acceptanceCriteria: drizzle-kit generate creates migration SQL files
Migration runner executes pending migrations on app launch
App handles first-time setup (empty DB) gracefully
App handles existing DB with pending migrations

userStories.title: Local user profile service
userStories.description: Create UserService for local user management. Since no backend yet, the 'current user' is stored locally. Support profile creation and update.
acceptanceCriteria: UserService with createUser, getCurrentUser, updateUser methods
User stored in SQLite users table
Current user ID persisted in MMKV for quick access
Currency defaults to device locale currency
Service properly typed with Drizzle inference

userStories.title: Relationship and children services
userStories.description: Create RelationshipService and ChildService. A relationship links two co-parents (parent_b can be null initially). Children belong to a relationship.
acceptanceCriteria: Invite generates unique token (for future partner onboarding)
All operations logged to audit_logs via AuditService

userStories.title: Audit service
userStories.description: Create AuditService that logs all data mutations. Every create/update/delete operation must create an audit_log entry. This is the foundation of legal defensibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions: create, update, soft_delete, acknowledge, dispute, respond
Entity types: user, relationship, child, entry, attachment, acknowledgment, dispute
Metadata stored as JSON (captures relevant context)
Audit logs are append-only (no update/delete methods)

userStories.title: File service with SHA-256 hashing
userStories.description: Create FileService for attachment handling. Files are copied to app storage and hashed with SHA-256. Hash is stored with attachment record for integrity verification.
acceptanceCriteria: FileService.saveFile(uri) copies file to app documents directory
SHA-256 hash computed during save using expo-crypto or react-native-crypto
FileService.getFilePath(storagePath) returns full path for display
Supported types: images (jpg, png, heic), PDFs, videos (mp4, mov)

userStories.title: Entry service — create with versioning
userStories.description: Create EntryService for all entry types. Every entry starts at version 1. Content stored in entry_versions table. Entry table points to current_version_id.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit log created for entry creation

userStories.title: Entry service — edit with version history
userStories.description: Implement entry editing that creates new versions. Original content preserved. Diff computed and stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates new entry_version with version_number incremented
Computes diff between old and new content (JSON diff)
New attachments linked to new version only

userStories.title: Entry service — soft delete
userStories.description: Implement soft delete for entries. No hard deletes allowed. Soft-deleted entries visible in audit trail but hidden from default views.
acceptanceCriteria: Does NOT delete entry_versions or attachments
Audit log created for soft_delete action

userStories.title: Entry content schemas — all 5 types
userStories.description: Define TypeScript types and Zod schemas for all 5 entry content types: expense, event, agreement, communication, upload.
acceptanceCriteria: ExpenseContent: amount (integer minor units), currency (ISO 4217), description, category, paid_by, split_type, receipt_attached
EventContent: title, start_time, end_time, location, responsible_parent, notes
Types exported for use in services and UI

userStories.title: Acknowledgment service
userStories.description: Create AcknowledgmentService. Entries start as 'pending' for the other parent. They can acknowledge or dispute.
acceptanceCriteria: Entry creator cannot acknowledge their own entry
Only one acknowledgment per entry (upsert pattern)
Disputing creates both acknowledgment (status=disputed) and dispute record

userStories.title: Dispute service with responses
userStories.description: Create DisputeService for managing disputes. Either parent can respond to a dispute. Responses are append-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit log for all dispute actions

userStories.title: Timeline service — query and filter
userStories.description: Create TimelineService for querying entries. Support filtering by date range, child, entry type, status. Paginated results.
acceptanceCriteria: TimelineService.query({ relationshipId, childId?, types?, dateFrom?, dateTo?, status?, limit, offset })
Returns entries with current version content populated
Includes acknowledgment status for each entry

userStories.title: Onboarding screens — profile setup
userStories.description: Create onboarding flow: name, timezone, currency. Minimal signup (no email/password yet since no backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation to main app after completion

userStories.title: Onboarding screens — relationship and children
userStories.description: Continue onboarding: create relationship, add children. Support 'invite partner later' flow.
acceptanceCriteria: AddChildScreen: name, date of birth inputs
Can add multiple children (list with add button)
InvitePartnerScreen: generate invite link/code (for future use)
Skip partner invite option (solo parent for now)
Creates relationship and children via services
Navigation to main app after completion

userStories.title: Timeline screen — main feed
userStories.description: Create the main timeline screen showing all entries. This is the home screen of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: TimelineScreen displays entries in reverse chronological order
Each entry shows: type icon, title/description, date, child (if applicable), acknowledgment status
FAB button to add new entry

userStories.title: Timeline filters
userStories.description: Add filter UI to timeline: by child, by entry type, by date range.
acceptanceCriteria: Child filter: multi-select from relationship children
Active filters shown as chips below header

userStories.title: Add expense entry screen
userStories.description: Create screen for adding expense entries. Multi-currency support.
acceptanceCriteria: Amount stored as integer (minor units: cents/pence)
Category picker (childcare, medical, education, clothing, activities, other)

userStories.title: Add event entry screen
userStories.description: Create screen for adding event entries (pickups, activities, appointments).

userStories.title: Add agreement entry screen
userStories.description: Create screen for recording agreements between co-parents.
acceptanceCriteria: Info text explaining agreement becomes part of record

userStories.title: Add communication entry screen
userStories.description: Create screen for structured communication entries. Not a chat — formal documented messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Info text explaining this creates permanent record

userStories.title: Add upload entry screen
userStories.description: Create screen for uploading documents (medical records, school reports, legal docs).
acceptanceCriteria: Document type picker (medical, school, legal, other)
Save creates entry with attachments hashed

userStories.title: Entry detail screen
userStories.description: Create detail view for a single entry. Shows full content, attachments, version history, acknowledgment status, disputes.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays entry content based on type
Each version shows timestamp, author, diff summary
Dispute section (if disputed) with all responses
Acknowledge/Dispute buttons for other parent's entries

userStories.title: PDF export — timeline report
userStories.description: Generate court-ready PDF export of timeline entries. Formatted for legal use.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF includes: title page with export date, filters applied
Entries listed chronologically with full content
Each entry shows: type, date, author, content, acknowledgment status
Attachments listed with filenames and hashes
Uses react-native-pdf or similar for generation

userStories.title: Evidence bundle export (ZIP)
userStories.description: Generate comprehensive evidence bundle as ZIP file: JSON data, PDF summary, all attachments, hash manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: ZIP contains: data.json, summary.pdf, attachments/, manifest.json
data.json: full entry data with versions, typed and structured
attachments/: all files with original names + hash suffix
manifest.json: file list with hashes for verification
manifest includes export timestamp and verification instructions

userStories.title: Export screen
userStories.description: Create UI for triggering exports. Filter selection and export type choice.
acceptanceCriteria: Export type selector: PDF Report / Evidence Bundle
Filter options: date range, children, entry types
Preview count: 'X entries will be exported'

userStories.title: Settings screen
userStories.description: Create settings screen with profile, preferences, and app info.
acceptanceCriteria: Children section: list children, edit names/DOB
Relationship section: show invite code, partner status
Export section: link to export screen
About section: app version, legal links
Danger zone: clear local data (with confirmation)

userStories.title: Main navigation structure
userStories.description: Set up tab navigation and stack navigators for the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom tabs: Timeline, Calendar (placeholder), Export, Settings
Timeline stack: TimelineScreen → EntryDetailScreen → Add screens
Root navigator switches between Onboarding and Main based on user state
